name: voxl-dev
description: Formatting, linting and type-checking for the web client (the build itself needs no packages).

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p web && tsc -p web/tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p web/tsconfig.worklet.json
scripts.test: node web/src/video-header.test.ts && node web/src/protocol.test.ts && node web/src/session.test.ts && node web/src/frames.test.ts && node web/src/stats.test.ts && node web/src/track.test.ts && node web/src/ring.test.ts && node web/src/keyboard.test.ts && node web/src/touch.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm fmt:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
